mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at mainly clear skies and a temperature of 64 degrees down by Firemans Park under a waning gibbous moon.

The Verona Police Department reminds residents that official records can be requested online through crashdocs.org, and the city is also reminding homeowners about the toilet rebate program for those installing high-efficiency models.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. The Remote Area Medical clinic is running today at Verona Area High School, and you can catch live music at Baileys Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today as well. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In a notable call from the past week, on Tuesday, July 21, a police drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating a person who had fled from a residence.

Today's flavor is the decadent OREO Cookie Cheesecake. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
